A '''spaceport''' in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] was the site of a [[Duel at unidentified Outer Rim spaceport/Legends|duel]] between two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]&mdash;[[Finn Ertay/Legends|Finn Ertay]] and a [[Unidentified Nikto Jedi/Legends|Nikto Jedi]]&mdash;and the [[Nightbrothers/Legends|Nightbrothers]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] and [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]], around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]]<ref name="Revival Date">{{FactFile2014|44|20 BBY 47-50|Maul on Mandalore}}</ref> during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Eventually, the two Jedi were both [[Death/Legends|killed]] in [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]].<ref name="Episode" />
